latHint: Think spotless, like a freshly scrubbed kitchen.
pivHint: A WASH is a thin layer of watercolor - but to WASH dishes is to make them what?
winText: Squeaky. WASH was the pivot - thin watercolor to making things CLEAN.
lossText: CLEAN - free of dirt. WASH was the pivot: a paint WASH, and to WASH dishes until they are CLEAN.
